tickets.summary: Risk-adjusted deposit limits for repeat customers
tickets.description: Calculate a deposit multiplier from successful returns, late events, damage claims, payment failures and account age. Show the final amount and explanation during checkout.
tickets.canonical_intent: Reduce or waive security deposits for trustworthy repeat renters.

tickets.summary: Reserve an adjacent garment size when fit confidence is low
tickets.description: For selected wedding inventory, hold one backup size under the same itinerary and release it after fit confirmation.
tickets.canonical_intent: Reduce fit failures by reserving a backup size for uncertain orders.

tickets.summary: Show cleaning and inspection provenance on product detail page
tickets.description: Expose last cleaning date, method, repair state and warehouse inspection completion for Bengaluru inventory.
tickets.canonical_intent: Increase rental trust through visible cleaning and readiness evidence.

tickets.summary: Predictive pickup nudges before customers miss return windows
tickets.description: Use wear date and courier capacity to send WhatsApp reminders and offer one-tap pickup rescheduling.
tickets.canonical_intent: Prevent late returns with event-aware reminders and flexible pickup.

tickets.summary: Rank only inventory that can be cleaned and delivered before event date
tickets.description: Availability and serviceability must gate retrieval before style relevance and popularity scoring.
tickets.canonical_intent: Rank rental inventory using event-date fulfilment feasibility.

tickets.summary: Evaluate virtual try-on SDKs for sarees and lehengas
tickets.description: Compare pose estimation and drape rendering vendors for a styling preview.
tickets.canonical_intent: Preview how a garment may look on a customer.

tickets.summary: Apply 10% discount when customers add three items
tickets.description: Generic multi-item cart discount for campaign traffic.
tickets.canonical_intent: Increase basket size with a volume discount.

tickets.summary: Red saree filter resets after changing delivery city
tickets.description: Preserve selected colour and price filters when serviceability location changes.

tickets.summary: Automate boutique partner payouts after return inspection
tickets.description: Release owner revenue share when the garment passes post-return inspection and all cost deductions are known.
tickets.canonical_intent: Automate settlement for wardrobe supply partners.

tickets.summary: Create a multi-event wedding outfit itinerary
tickets.description: Connect looks, accessories, delivery dates and pickup windows across haldi, mehendi, sangeet and reception.
tickets.canonical_intent: Coordinate multiple rental looks as one wedding event plan.
